2. Specification 
2.1 Communication protocol 
2.1.1 REST Web service 
The Gespage public web services are using REST protocol, which encapsulates requests/responses in 
HTTP messages. The HTTP messages have to be encoded in US-ASCII. 
 
The data carried in HTTP body is encoded in JSON format. In each JSON response, a return code field 
is included to indicate the command success/failure. 
 
It is recommended that the communication between web service client and the print server is 
encrypted using SSL 
 
By default, the Gespage server is reachable on ports 7180 and 7181 (SSL). 
2.1.2 Caller identification 
The public web services credentials consist in 2 advanced parameters that have to be set up in 
Gespage administration menus. 
- 
public.api.login : 
A unique identifier of the public client 
- 
public.api.password: The secret of the public client 
 
Note: the length of the password must be 8 characters minimum.

2.2.1 General 
2.2.1.1 GET credentials 
This command checks the caller is allowed to use the Gespage Public Web Service API. It provides a 
token required for other requests. 
 
The caller should GET again the credentials each time it receives a ‘490 – Invalid token’ error. 
 
The credentials have to be set up in Gespage administration menus. 
 
Request 
 
Command 
GET 
URI 
/pserver/rs/public/credentials/{id}/{secret} 
Param path 
id [string] 
 
Public API id 
secret [string] 
 
Public API secret 
Response 
 
JSON return code 
200 – OK 
401 – Unauthorized 
 Invalid credentials 
403 – Forbidden 
 Invalid licence 
404 – Not Found  No access allowed to client 
500 – Internal Server Error 
 Server generic error 
JSON body 
ret_code [integer] 
 
JSON return code 
token [string] 
 
API token
